messages:
Priya (Marketing): Heads-up 14 need a refreshed battlecard bundle for next week's webinar. Focus: concise benchmark narrative vs managed cloud endpoints + 3 rebut snips for procurement and infra teams.

Jordan (Product): Core pillars to highlight: unified runtime across deployment modes, cost controls (batching + cache), and controlled rollouts/fallbacks. Need numbers for p95 and cost delta.

Mateo (Eng-ML): I27ll run a trimmed benchmark and drop the CSV. Early numbers show ~30% lower cost_per_1k for typical chat QPS after batching; p95 improvement 20-40ms vs CloudX. Will confirm.

Sam (Sales): SDR-friendly one-liners please: latency, cost, security. Keep each <20 words.

Lila (Growth): Webinar headline candidates: "Predictable inference. Predictable costs." and "Ship LLM features without surprise bills." I27ll AB test both on the landing page.

Ava (Field): Procurement foil line: "Managed cloud endpoints are convenient; Redwood is a serving runtime with private deployment and governance controls 26 rollout tooling." Add KMS/HSM note.

Mateo (Eng-ML): Quick bench command I27m running:
```
./bench --model redwood-v1 --compare cloudx-gpt --seq 128 --qps 100
# output: p50,p95,cost_per_1k
```

Priya (Marketing): Action items: Jordan add fallback examples + SDK streaming note to battlecard; Mateo attach final bench; Lila run headline test; Sam craft three SDR snippets + two rebut bullets per claim; Ava prepare a 2-slide live demo script for webinar.

launch-bot: Reminder: Battlecard draft due 2026-07-12 16:00 UTC.

Sam (Sales): Draft SDR snippets: 
- Cost: "Reduce per-token spend with batching and cache; measurable savings at scale."
- Latency: "Engineered p95s for production SLAs 2D no surprise tails."
- Security: "Private control plane, VPC options, and KMS integrations for compliance."

Priya (Marketing): Thanks all 12 I27ll compile and share updated JSON battlecard by EOD Friday. Ping me if blocked. :raised_hands:
